question: Malcolm can run a race at a speed of 6 minutes per mile, while Joshua runs at 8 minutes per mile. In a 10-mile race, how many minutes after Malcolm crosses the finish line will Joshua cross the finish line if they start the race together?

answer:
Malcolm runs at a pace of 6 minutes per mile, and Joshua runs at a pace of 8 minutes per mile. To find out how many minutes after Malcolm crosses the finish line Joshua will finish, we need to calculate the total time each takes to complete the 10-mile race and then find the difference between these times.

First, we calculate Malcolm's total time:
\[
\text{Malcolm's total time} = 10 \text{ miles} \times 6 \text{ minutes/mile} = 60 \text{ minutes}
\]

Next, we calculate Joshua's total time:
\[
\text{Joshua's total time} = 10 \text{ miles} \times 8 \text{ minutes/mile} = 80 \text{ minutes}
\]

The difference in their finish times is:
\[
80 \text{ minutes} - 60 \text{ minutes} = 20 \text{ minutes}
\]

Thus, Joshua will cross the finish line \boxed{20} minutes after Malcolm.
